provenance.description: Grand Rapids voting precinct boundaries, 59 since the 2025 consolidation
provenance.source: State of Michigan, Secretary of State
provenance.simplification_note: Thinned for browser delivery. Verified to change no answer for addresses more than 5 m from a precinct line.
provenance.licence: Public record of the State of Michigan, redistributed as published.
provenance.how_to_update: Run refresh_precincts.py. Do not hand-edit the geometry: these are polygons with thousands of coordinates. The script refuses to write unless the state layer still returns 59 precincts, numbered 1-59, in wards 1-20 / 21-40 / 41-59, with no overlapping shapes.
provenance.why_the_state_not_the_city: The City of Grand Rapids publishes its own precinct layer, but 86 pairs of its polygons overlap, so about 1 in 100 addresses falls inside two precincts at once with no way to choose. The state layer has no overlaps and otherwise matches the city's almost exactly.
